# Watchmaker workbench, golden hour to moonlight

**Creator-reported model · Source-only; not independently reproduced**

The two 2048 × 1152 WebP files show a workbench changing from warm golden-hour light to blue moonlight. Gears, springs and tools retain their broad arrangement, but small dial details differ, so exact pixel or object preservation is not claimed. The warm image is an input reference whose original model is unknown, not another 2.6 output. Source settings are medium quality and low complexity.
